user.title: Works with Alexa
user.description: Choose how to connect your Amazon account.

menu_options.import_alexa_media: Borrow the sign-in from Alexa Media Player (recommended)
menu_options.login: Sign in to Amazon (not working yet)

import_alexa_media.title: Borrow from Alexa Media Player
import_alexa_media.description: Reuse the Amazon sign-in that Alexa Media Player already holds, with no second sign-in and no new device registration. That integration keeps working; sharing the token does not disturb its session.

login.title: Sign in to Amazon (not working yet)
login.description: This path is unfinished and is not expected to succeed. Amazon answers a new device registration with a challenge whose page will not load through the sign-in relay, so it stops partway. Use one of the other options instead. If you want to try it anyway: after you submit, a window opens for Amazon's own sign-in, and the Home Assistant URL below must be the one your browser can reach.

data.hass_url: Home Assistant URL (as your browser reaches it)

import_token.title: Use an existing credential bundle
import_token.description: Paste a credential bundle from an account that is already registered. It must contain the refresh token, macDms and device serial. The marketplace below is only used if the bundle does not name one.

select_devices.title: Choose devices
select_devices.description: Your Amazon account has {count} devices. Tick the ones you want in Home Assistant. You can change this later without signing in again.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Amazon
reauth_confirm.description: Your stored credentials are no longer accepted. Submit to sign in again; your existing configuration is kept.

error.login_failed: Login did not complete. Make sure you finished Amazon's sign-in, and try from a browser not already signed in to Amazon.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Amazon. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_bundle: That is not a usable credential bundle. It must be JSON containing refreshToken, macDms and deviceSerial.
error.invalid_auth: Amazon rejected those credentials. The refresh token may have been revoked.

abort.already_configured: This Amazon account is already set up.
abort.proxy_missing: The login session was lost. Start again.
abort.no_alexa_media: No Alexa Media Player account with a stored sign-in was found.
abort.wrong_account: That sign-in was for a different Amazon account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

init.title: Works with Alexa options
init.description: Unticking a device removes its entities. Changes reload the integration.
